references.text: Contrast between circumcision as a covenant sign (Abraham) and circumcision as strategic treachery (Shechem).
Parallel action (circumcision) that illuminates the difference between holy obedience and hypocrisy.
Contrast between circumcision as a covenant sign and as a tactical weapon.
Fulfillment of consequence: Evil counsel (Genesis) leads to God's judgment upon their heads (Judges).
Contrast between divine covenant requirement and human coercion that misuses the ritual.
